Feeling constantly tired can have many causes. Here are some common reasons:

**Lifestyle factors:**
- Poor sleep quality or not enough sleep (less than 7-9 hours)
- Lack of physical activity or overexertion
- Poor diet or dehydration
- Too much caffeine or alcohol
- High stress levels

**Medical conditions:**
- Anemia (low iron)
- Thyroid problems
- Sleep disorders (like sleep apnea)
- Diabetes
- Chronic fatigue syndrome
- Depression or anxiety
- Vitamin deficiencies (D, B12)

**When to see a doctor:**
- Fatigue lasting more than 2 weeks
- Accompanied by other symptoms (chest pain, shortness of breath, unexplained weight changes)
- Severely impacting your daily life

**Simple things to try:**
- Maintain a consistent sleep schedule
- Exercise regularly (even light activity helps)
- Eat balanced meals
- Stay hydrated
- Limit screen time before bed
- Manage stress

If lifestyle changes don't help, it's worth getting a checkup. A doctor can run tests to identify any underlying conditions.
